objective: Transfer observable SMAC behavior to GLSMAC using independent original observations and candidate replay.

domains.coverage: 84 warning traces cover edited inputs, inclusive threshold 128, common-source text, clamped choice navigation and confirmation/caller return. Four generated original worlds establish selected full widths, retained odd heights and valid tile counts. 82 faction-setup sequences add 603 original checkpoints for roster slots, modes, leader fields, caps and source profiles. 22 post-generation original observations add six selected identity fields, name confirmation, empty names and custom/source values. Candidate native storage/codecs and browser startup are checked separately. Four independently repeated original Sentry activation traces match headless native replay and real browser A/arrows/Enter/Escape/W/Tab: cancellation preserves orders, confirmation activates only the chosen unit, exhausted activation never refunds movement, and W clears exhausted focus. Native navigation notification delivery is shared with the frontend. Other layouts/counts, work cancellation and enemy waking remain unobserved. Five independently repeated first-starvation traces match native display-free replay and actual browser controls: common STARVE text, indexed labels, real choice navigation, population held at two until confirmation, and one-citizen removal with Zoom/Proceed continuation. Eleven application scenarios separately check pending-turn guards, authoritative validation, rollback, event observer acknowledgement and cleanup. Artwork/audio, future suppression preferences, other modifiers, raw signed nutrient counters and general starvation/economy remain unobserved. Mineral credit is limited to its separate incomplete-project contract. Four further independently repeated original first-notice controls match native replay and real browser input: normal Escape confirms the current highlight and reaches full base management or map, Shift+Escape preserves the pending notice and two citizens, and suppression immediately confirms Proceed and returns to the map. Eleven application scenarios separately check matching native receipts, delayed acknowledgement, duplicate/stale controls, rejection/retry, cleanup and rollback. Future suppression preferences and later notices remain unobserved. Eleven independently repeated owned-base Rename traces match native replay and actual browser input: source-driven common RENAME/labels, native raw names, visible drafts/titles, confirm/cancel/reopen, empty and space-preserving names and a 24-character ASCII field limit. Thirteen native application scenarios separately cover authority, rollback, lifetime, stale callbacks and cleanup; seven shared-editor scenarios and actual x/z typing check application input behavior. Other cities, duplicate policies, Unicode, persistence/network and full base-management remain unobserved. Twelve independently repeated original in-game menu traces compare all nine headers, source-driven labels and edited GAME title, ordered child rows/separators/text tones, switching, child Escape and MENU toggles at 63 checkpoints with city/unit/year guards. All twelve match display-free production replay and actual browser pointer/SDL controls, with native pointer access to every visited child final row. Subsequent hover previews are outside the contract; initial rendered Scout and both actual production selection controllers remain guarded. Ten native application scenarios cover source validation, lazy mounting, retained controls, land/water wording and existing New Game/Quit callback identity. Other original row effects, availability, hints, shortcuts, contexts and full menu/game behavior remain unobserved. Six independently repeated original ui.unit_menu_orders.v1 traces (30 complete checkpoints) match native display-free replay and all six actual browser pointer/SDL Tab traces. In the declared healthy, unspent Scout fixture, Action source slots 26/29/30 apply Sentry/Hold/Skip with movement spent 0/0/3 thirds, select the Former while retaining the root menu and clearing its child/highlight, then Tab closes the root and selects the Colony Pod. Two declared source profiles preserve slot identity despite edited wording. City, all unit identities/membership/health and year remain guarded. Nineteen application scenarios/443 assertions separately check existing native handlers, receipt authority, failed submissions, popup/pending guards, stale callbacks and context row restoration; these are not additional original cases. A separate fresh-worker unit-menu-context-orders application suite adds one Former/Hold restoration scenario and eleven assertions, preserving the existing nineteen-scenario suite and runtime limits. The complete independently repeated ui.unit_menu_context.v1 HOT reference covers twelve Former/Colony Sentry/Hold/Skip inputs under synthetic and edited source profiles, with 78 complete checkpoints. All twelve match strict current-production/native replay without further production changes; five selected context cases match actual browser pointer/SDL input, not a full twelve-case rendered replay. The Former Action child has twenty rows (sixteen light labels and four separators); Colony has twenty-two (seventeen light labels and five separators), including source slot 1 in its own leading group. Native Sentry/Hold preserve movement and Skip spends one movement point; both profiles retain source-slot command identity and the recorded selection/menu/Tab lifecycle. The full reference supersedes three immutable pilot records, counting nine additional inputs and no duplicate pilot passes. Initial orders, spent movement, active work, other commands, turn effects and general availability remain outside this contract. Eight independently repeated Terraform-menu work traces connect Farm/Mine/Forest/Road through native work handlers; two owned-city Colony Action traces connect native join and Pod consumption. Three further independently repeated presentation traces transfer ready Former row membership, actual tones, source names and nominal work times one through four, plus retained header behavior through Escape/Tab/reopening. Eleven application scenarios/69 assertions separately cover eligibility, prerequisites and control lifetime. No advanced work callbacks, Colony Terraform eligibility or AI parity are implied by those Terraform traces. The existing19/443 Action regression now executes as three independent groups with every original assertion retained. Two independently repeated free-tile Colony Action naming traces match native replay at twenty checkpoints: common NEWBASE caption/field text, declared faction name pools, real edit/cancel/reopen/button and keyboard confirmation, chosen raw city name and native Pod consumption. Post-confirm artwork, general name/adjacency policy and AI remain outside this contract. Two independently repeated nearby-city Action traces cover the immediate response on one southwest neighboring square under two synthetic common BASETOONEAR/menu profiles: no naming dialog, preserved Pod/unit/city state and selection, retained root/cleared child, and actual rendered source-driven warning. Other neighbors, general distance policy and message duration remain outside original evidence.
